route_67_laafu_layout.summary: Tests the one actionable R66 lead (Parisel / thesis 9): is the LAAFU residue content or layout? Blind 2-leg harness (statistician + paleographer), pre-registered as degenerate-likely (LAAFU should yield to LAYOUT, not content). The decisive control is paleographic-head subtraction: collapsing calligraphic HEAD identities (line-initial gallows littera notabilior p/t + line-final justification -m/-g/-dy) drops laafu_I from 0.471 to 0.307, near the R62 baseline 0.303, explaining 97.6% of the gap. Miller-Madow debiased = 0.4395 (the signal is not finite-sample inflation). Within-Currier the effect is real per mode: A=0.589, B=0.487.
route_67_laafu_layout.reading: The LAAFU residue is calligraphic LAYOUT, not content: subtracting line-initial gallows littera-notabilior and line-final justification heads explains 97.6% of the gap over the R62 generator (0.471 to 0.307 ~ baseline 0.303), and the debiased estimate rules out finite-sample inflation. The mechanical label is laafu_mixed (diffuse closure; borderline section likely a section-vocabulary confound), but the reading is LAYOUT, so a head-identity-aware edge bias lets the content-free generator reach effectively 14/14 signatures. Parisel's lead folds into the generator; priors are nudged not moved (70/22/8).

route_70_hebrew_alphagram.summary: Isola e ataca a versão algorítmica da tese hebraica (Kondrak & Hauer 2018), distinta das decifrações pontuais (R66 t13). Pilar falsificável: o ALFAGRAMA (cada palavra é um anagrama alfabético) exige uma ordem TOTAL dos glifos. Três medidas, duas independentes da ordem (decidedness de pares e ciclos de maioria), mais arbitragem contra o gerador R62 e passes glifo-EVA/abjad/frequência.
route_70_hebrew_alphagram.claim: Kondrak & Hauer 2018: cada palavra Voynich = palavra hebraica abjad (sem vogais) + letras reordenadas em ordem alfabética (alfagrama)
route_70_hebrew_alphagram.reading: The Hebrew claim has two forms and the repo had attacked only one. Point decipherments (Cheshire/Bax/Gibbs) are R66 thesis 13, dead by char_h2=2.15. The ALGORITHMIC form (Kondrak & Hauer 2018) was never isolated: they propose each word is a Hebrew word abjad-stripped of vowels and re-sorted into alphabetical order (an alphagram). That mechanism implies a TOTAL glyph order, so it is falsifiable without a key. On the full corpus only 27.3% of tokens are non-decreasing under the best order (a true alphagram ceiling = 100%, shuffle floor = 6.3%), only 34.7% of glyph pairs are strictly ordered (124/190 are ambiguous), and the majority order contains 15 three-cycles, proving no total order can sort every word. The modest order lift is reproduced by the content-free R62 generator (real 0.273 vs gen 0.277), so it is templatic morphology, not alphabetic re-sorting. Stripping candidate vowels (abjad) does not rescue a total order (decided 0.42, still cycles), and the sorted letter-frequency profile ties Hebrew (1.00) with English (0.997) by Zipf, so a frequency match is non-discriminating. The glyph-unit pass (ch/sh as units) refutes identically. Verdict hebrew_alphagram_refuted: this closes the gap in R66 thesis 13 — the algorithmic form dies by its own declared mechanism. Priors frozen 70/22/8. Right-to-left reading is Rota 69's scope, kept separate.

route_71_constructed_language.question: Could the manuscript be a 'lingua ignota' (constructed language)? Asked by the user; answered by positioning the hypothesis against the closed ledger R43-R70, not by new measurement.
route_71_constructed_language.two_hypotheses: H_broad = a constructed sign system deliberately designed (the prior's ~22% 'construida' branch, and the family the ~70% content-free generator belongs to); H_hildegard = the specific Hildegard von Bingen Lingua Ignota model (a glossed, noun-dominated, referential invented vocabulary).
route_71_constructed_language.reading: H_broad (a constructed SYSTEM) is unrefuted: designed combinatorial morphology (R43-55), syntax-thin bag-of-words (R60), non-natural prose h2=2.15 (R58), morph-rich/syntax-fine (R59) and serious deliberate multi-scribe production (R68: blocked p=0.001, 5 hands, V(hand x Currier)=0.98) all support it; nothing weakens it -- it is the surviving ~22% branch. H_hildegard (the glossed nomenclator model) is WEAKENED (weakens 4 > supports 3): nomenclator excluded (R57), label<->object decoupled (R63-65), no gloss/parallel key (R68), lexicon scale/morphology unlike a ~1000-item noun list (R59). Neither is confirmable by statistics because the R62/R67 content-free generator reproduces 14/14 signatures, so a constructed system WITH content is indistinguishable from one WITHOUT on the token scale. Only a documented key/crib (#1, which also separates constructed-language from cipher) or a decode predicting held-out folios (#6) can move it. Priors frozen 70/22/8. No new corpus statistic; assigns no meaning to any token.
